entries.question: Book appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, please follow these guidelines:

**Important Information:**
*   **Online registration is mandatory.**
*   The OPD slip fee is **₹50** for all booking methods.
*   Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   The Parchi/ticket counter closes at **1:00 PM sharp**.
*   Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid severe wait times.

**Booking Methods:**
1.  **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, choose your department/date/time, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
2.  **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection flow as ORS.
3.  **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to the registration counter. You will receive an OTP, be issued a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

**OPD Timings:**
*   **Monday–Friday:** 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
*   **Saturday:** 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
*   **Sundays:** Closed

If you need further assistance or have specific medical queries, please visit the official website at [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) or call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**. 

*Note: I am an AI assistant and cannot provide medical advice or diagnose conditions. Please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD for any health concerns. Please avoid sharing personal details like your Aadhaar or phone number in this chat.*

* **Surgical Gastroenterology:** सोमवार, बुधवार और शुक्रवार (कक्ष संख्या 202)।

entries.question: Oral ulcer aur tumor k liye kis department me doctor ko dikhana jaruri hai
entries.answer:

Aap KGMU ke in departments mein sampark kar sakte hain:

*   **Oral Medicine & Radiology:** Yeh विभाग मुंह ke chalon (ulcers) aur anya samasyaon ke diagnosis ke liye hai.
*   **Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery:** Agar tumor ya gath (lump) ki surgery ya biopsy ki zaroorat hoti hai, toh yeh department dekhta hai.

**Zaroori Jaankari:**
*   KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration mandatory hai. Aap [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jaakar appointment book kar sakte hain.
*   OPD ka samay: Somvaar se Shukravaar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivaar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM).
*   OPD slip ki fees ₹50 hai.
*   Kripya dhyan dein ki main ek AI hoon aur medical advice nahi de sakta. Sahi jaanch aur treatment ke liye turant doctor se paramarsh lein.

Sath hi, please chat mein apni personal jaankari (jaise phone number ya health records) share na karein.

*   **Doctor se Salah:** Cancer ki aashanka hone par turant biopsy ya sahi jaanch karwana zaroori hota hai, isliye aap Oral Medicine ya Surgical Oncology mein se kisi bhi department mein doctor se milkar apni report aur samasya dikha sakte hain. entries.question: Cardiology opd appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the Cardiology OPD at KGMU, please use one of the following official methods. **Online registration is mandatory.**

### Booking Methods
*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Register or log in, select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, and select the Cardiology department to book your slot.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can also use the ABHA app to register and book an appointment by following the same hospital selection flow.
*   **SMS Service:** Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital with your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP, collect a physical token, and pay the ₹50 registration fee at the counter.

*   **OPD Timings:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM. (Closed on Sundays).

*   **Referral:** Patients arriving from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
*   **Emergency:** If this is a cardiac emergency, do not wait for an OPD appointment. Please go directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** for stabilization, after which patients are typically transferred to the LARI Cardiology department.
*   **Avoid Delays:** Pre-booking your appointment is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
